title: Gharsang
content:
The gharsang are the wooden idols depicting the lords of the sky and the lords of the underworld that are venerated by the [[orcs]]. For two different takes on the lords of the sky, see [[27.01]] and [[25.01]].

The lords of the sky apparently give substantial boons to the orc race, including a rain of gold. The lords of the sky and of the underworld are represented as gharsang - hideous leering faces carved from wood. The orcs believe that the idols scare off evil spirits, strip away illusions and guard orcish lands against enchantment. [[Gruumsch]] is chief of the lords of the underworld.
